body:
## Philanthropy

We at FIJI do not believe that the world takes men's mental health seriously enough. The chapter gives to the American Foundation for Suicide Prevention for that reason alone. We pool donations and philanthropic works into a single amount sent in the chapter's name.

The philanthropy car wash is planned and run by the latest new member class each year. It is the first thing they build for the chapter, instilling the value of Service into FIJI members from the very start. Everything it raises supports AFSP.

A gift does not have to go to AFSP. It can go directly to one of the memorial funds the chapter carries, each described under Philanthropy & Scholarships. The chapter appreciates any and all donations to our philanthropic connections, and we pride ourselves on the amount we get to send each year. Give to the one that means something to you.
